name: Select — Returning trainee offered persona switch

chat_history.message: Hey Alex, good to have you here — ready to sharpen your discovery skills today?
Last time you went with a developer. Want to try the CTO/VP this time for variety, or stick with that?

success_conditions: Agent acknowledges the trainee's previous session with the developer persona
Agent offers to switch to the other persona or stick with the same one
Agent asks only one clear question — does not ask multiple questions at once
Agent does not re-introduce itself by name
Agent does not act as the persona yet — stays in host/router mode
simulation_scenario: A returning trainee named Alex who previously practiced with the Developer persona. The select node should acknowledge their history and offer to switch to the CTO/VP or repeat the Developer.
